messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image, using the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image. Use the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character walks forward toward the camera, then bends down to adjust the strap of her right sandal, and finally stands upright and turns her head to look around.","camera":"A vertical, eye-level shot that starts as a full-body view and slowly zooms in to a medium shot as the character approaches.","clothing":"A long, sleeveless red satin dress with gold and green floral embroidery on the bodice and waist, paired with a light gray knitted shawl draped over the shoulders and black strappy sandals.","hair_color":"Reddish-brown.","hairstyle":"Reddish-brown hair styled in two high buns on top of the head, with a center part and bangs framing the face.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with a slender build, fair skin, and a stylized anime-like face.","scene":"An outdoor rural environment with a dirt path, tall green grass, and a traditional thatched-roof building in the background under a clear blue sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from an indoor corridor with a clock and tiled floor to an outdoor rural setting with a thatched-roof building, dirt path, grass, and blue sky, closely matching the reference. The character, hairstyle, red dress, gray shawl, sandals, walking/adjusting-sandal action, and forward camera approach remain largely consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the indoor station-like scene with the outdoor rural environment from the reference image, while preserving the same character, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, action, camera framing/movement, and natural lighting.
uncertain: Whether the camera movement is exactly identical to the source, since the new scene changes parallax and framing context
unexpected_changes: The dress appears brighter red and more satin-like in the output than in the source
The character's skin tone and facial rendering look slightly different in the new lighting
